exercises.q: Extract Image 2 (page 2) and identify the GPS coordinates.
exercises.a: GPS: 36.1699°N, 115.1398°W — Las Vegas, Nevada. Use: mutool extract lab06.pdf  then  exiftool <image_file>

exercises.q: What does the EXIF Make/Model on page 2 reveal?
exercises.a: SAMSUNG SM-G991B — a Samsung Galaxy smartphone. Document claims images are 'scanned' but this is a phone photo.

exercises.q: Compare EXIF Make across all three pages. What is the forensic significance?
exercises.a: Page 1: Canon scanner; Page 2: Samsung smartphone; Page 3: Fujifilm mirrorless camera. Three different capture devices in one supposedly uniformly-scanned document.

exercises.q: Using peepdf3, list all annotations and their authors.
exercises.a: pdf> object <page_obj_num>  → check /Annots array → object each annotation → read /T (author) and /Contents
